import json, subprocess, os, wave, numpy as np, base64
def run(calls, tag="c"):
    p=f"/workspace/work/{tag}.json"
    json.dump(calls, open(p,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch",p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    out=r.stdout.strip()
    if r.returncode!=0 or '"isError": true' in out:
        print("ERR:",out[-3000:])
    return out
def call(name,args,tag="c"):
    return run([{"name":name,"arguments":args}],tag)
def render(path,rate=44100,bits=16,amp=32,loops=1):
    return call("module_render",{"path":path,"rate":rate,"bits":bits,"amp":amp,"loops":loops},"r")
def load_wav(path):
    w=wave.open(path); n=w.getnframes()
    d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(n),dtype='<i2').astype(np.float64)
    if w.getnchannels()==2: return d[0::2],d[1::2]
    return d,d
def pcm16(x):
    x=np.clip(x,-1,1)
    return base64.b64encode((x*32767).astype('<i2').tobytes()).decode()
def spec_peak(x, sr=44100, fmin=20, fmax=20000):
    x=x*np.hanning(len(x))
    sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr)
    m=(f>=fmin)&(f<=fmax)
    i=np.argmax(sp[m]); return f[m][i]

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > work/insp.py <<'PY'
import struct, numpy as np, sys
path=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'work/dur2.xm'
b=open(path,'rb').read()
shp=739
length=88200
d=np.frombuffer(b[shp+40:shp+40+length],dtype='<i2')
print('nsamples',len(d))
zc=np.nonzero(np.diff(np.sign(d)))[0]
print('freq in sample', len(zc)/2/(len(d)/44100))
env=np.abs(d)
print('env every 0.1s', [int(env[int(i*4410)]/1000) for i in range(19)])
t=np.arange(10)/44100
orig=(np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)*0.9*32767).astype('<i2')
print('orig',orig[:10])
print('stored',d[:10])
PY
python3 work/insp.py"}

path=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'work/dur2.xm'
b=open(path,'rb').read()
shp=739
length=88200
d=np.frombuffer(b[shp+40:shp+40+length],dtype='<i2')
print('nsamples',len(d))
zc=np.nonzero(np.diff(np.sign(d)))[0]
print('freq in sample', len(zc)/2/(len(d)/44100))
env=np.abs(d)
print('env every 0.1s', [int(env[int(i*4410)]/1000) for i in range(19)])
t=np.arange(10)/44100
orig=(np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)*0.9*32767).astype('<i2')
print('orig',orig[:10])
print('stored',d[:10])
PY
python3 work/insp.py"}

path=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'work/dur2.xm'
b=open(path,'rb').read()
shp=739
length=88200
d=np.frombuffer(b[shp+40:shp+40+length],dtype='<i2')
print('nsamples',len(d))
zc=np.nonzero(np.diff(np.sign(d)))[0]
print('freq in sample', len(zc)/2/(len(d)/44100))
env=np.abs(d)
print('env every 0.1s', [int(env[int(i*4410)]/1000) for i in range(19)])
t=np.arange(10)/44100
orig=(np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)*0.9*32767).astype('<i2')
print('orig',orig[:10])
print('stored',d[:10])
PY
python3 work/insp.py"}

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
from ft import *
import wave
SR=44100
# sample with exactly 1 cycle over 441 samples => 100 Hz at 44100
N=441
t=np.arange(N)/SR
s=(np.sin(2*np.pi*t)*0.9*32767).astype('<i2')
w=wave.open('work/onecyc.wav','wb'); w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR)
w.writeframes(s.tobytes()); w.close()
run([{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":2,"name":"OC"}},
     {"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":125,"speed":6}},
     {"name":"sample_load","arguments":{"path":"work/onecyc.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}},
     {"name":"sample_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"volume":64,"panning":128,"relative_note":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":0,"flags":0}},
     {"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":"C-4","instrument":1,"volume":64}},
     {"name":"module_render","arguments":{"path":"work/oc.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}}],"oc")
L,R=load_wav("work/oc.wav")
seg=L[int(0.2*SR):int(1.0*SR)]
seg=seg*np.hanning(len(seg))
sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/SR)
i=np.argmax(sp)
print("peak freq", round(f[i],2), "=> implied base", round(f[i]*441/1,1))
EOF"}

# 100 cycles of a sine in 44100 samples => 100 Hz, 1 second
N=44100
t=np.arange(N)/SR
s=(np.sin(2*np.pi*100*t)*0.9*32767).astype('<i2')
import wave
w=wave.open('work/h100.wav','wb'); w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR)
w.writeframes(s.tobytes()); w.close()
run([{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":2,"name":"H100"}},
     {"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":125,"speed":6}},
     {"name":"sample_load","arguments":{"path":"work/h100.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}},
     {"name":"sample_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"volume":64,"panning":128,"relative_note":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":0,"flags":0}},
     {"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":"C-4","instrument":1,"volume":64}},
     {"name":"module_render","arguments":{"path":"work/h100r.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}}],"h100")
EOF"}
